_about: Each national park's day hikes as listed on its own nps.gov hiking pages, with the distance, time and difficulty those pages state (null where they don't). distanceKind is as the page states it; one-way distances are doubled by scripts/build-park-hikes.mjs. Compiled by reading the pages in each park's sources.

acadia.note: Read by the build script from the hike lists on the Hiking page and the category pages it links to (Mount Desert Island, Schoodic, summit, coastal, lake and forest, loops, out-and-back, Island Explorer), with each hike's distance from its own page.

american-samoa.note: Trails listed on trails.htm. The Easy and Moderate ratings for Pola Island, Lower Sauma Ridge and Tuafanua come from the park's Day Hikes brochure PDF, which hiking.htm links to. The Strenuous ratings for Fatifati Auala and Mount 'Alava come from their own pages, which call them 'Challenging', and for the Adventure Trail from the brochure. Fatifati Auala uses the longer option, 5.8 mi to the Mt. Alava summit, and the page does not say whether that is one way or round trip. Si'u Point's difficulty could not be read reliably from the brochure. Brochure trails outside the park, such as Le'ala Shoreline, Blunts Point and Tumu Mountain, were left out.

arches.note: hiking.htm lists two dynamic sets of nps.gov/places pages ('Short and Moderate Hikes' and 'Longer, More Strenuous Hikes'). The facts come from each place page's Roundtrip Distance, Time and Difficulty fields, and pages that describe several hikes are split into one entry per hike. Courthouse Towers Viewpoint was left out because it is the other end of the Park Avenue Trail. Fiery Furnace, a permit or ranger-led area, has no stated distance and is rated Strenuous from its section.

badlands.note: hiking-trails.htm is a dynamic list of trailhead pages with few numbers. Distance and difficulty come from the park's 'Hiking the Badlands' Things To Do page, which lists the official trails. Notch Trail is listed there as 'Moderate to strenuous' and recorded as Strenuous. Deer Haven is an unmaintained network of game trails with no stated distance.

big-bend.note: day_hikes.htm links to three pages: Desert, Mountain and River hikes. Each trail's difficulty and distance line was transcribed from those pages. South Rim (12–14.5 mi) uses the larger figure, Panther Path (50 yards) is about 0.03 mi, and Tuff Canyon's '0..5 mile' typo was read as 0.5. Boot Canyon Trail uses its 3.5 mi one-way figure from the Basin trailhead; it continues another 2.5 mi to the South Rim.

biscayne.note: Biscayne is 95% water and has no hiking page. The only walks the park describes are the Convoy Point Jetty Walk at the visitor center and short island trails reached by boat. The Elliott Key and Boca Chita Key trails are not named on their pages, so they are labelled by island. Spite Highway is described only as running about six miles down Elliott Key.

black-canyon-of-the-gunnison.note: Distances and difficulty come from the Trails Overview table on hikingtrails.htm, where distances are one way unless noted. Several linked trail pages rate trails harder than the table, for example Warner Point as 'Moderate strenuous' and Oak Flat or Rim Rock as 'Moderately strenuous'. Cedar Point Nature Trail is not in the table, so its facts come from its own page. Inner-canyon wilderness routes were left out.

bryce-canyon.note: Taken from the Hike List tables on day-hikes.htm (Easy, Moderate and Strenuous) and each hike's linked Things To Do page. Rim Trail runs 1–11 mi depending on how far you walk, and its own page says 'Easy to Moderate', so it is recorded as Moderate even though the list puts it under Easy. Backcountry overnight trails were left out.

hikes.name: Sunset Point to Sunrise Point Hike

canyonlands.note: From the Island in the Sky, Needles and Maze tables (all 'Distance (round-trip)'). Left out Lower Red Lake Canyon and Salt Creek Canyon (listed as overnight). 'Easy/Moderate' Needles section mapped to Moderate. The three White Rim Road / Taylor Canyon Road trails sit under no difficulty heading (null). Upheaval Dome distance is to the first overlook; Maze Overlook is listed as '1 mile (12 km)' on the page (km figure looks like a typo).

hikes.name: Big Spring to Wooden Shoe Canyon
Big Spring Canyon to Lost Canyon
Big Spring Canyon to Elephant Canyon
Maze Overlook (mesa top to canyon bottom)

capitol-reef.note: Fruita trails from the Trail Guide table (one-way distances; the two loops are marked round trip; no times given). Waterpocket and Cathedral district route descriptions, plus the 'Day Hikes and Routes' slot canyons (one-way distances to turnaround, 'difficult') and Sulphur Creek (5.8 mi one-way shuttle hike, unrated). Left out the 'Backpacking Routes' section (Pleasant Creek, Spring Canyon, Upper/Lower Muley Twist, Halls Creek Narrows) even though some can be long day hikes. 'Easy to moderate' mapped to Moderate; Lower Cathedral Valley Overlooks range 1.5–2.5 mi recorded as 2.5.

hikes.name: Jailhouse Rock and Temple Rock Route

carlsbad-caverns.note: Surface trails linked from Desert Hiking Trails; facts from each trail's own page (no table). Walnut Canyon Overlook is 180 yards (recorded 0.1 mi). Times are the pages' one-way travel times; distances usually lack round-trip/one-way wording. Left out Guadalupe Ridge (12 mi, 14 hours) and the long-distance Guadalupe Ridge Trail as backpacking routes. Page notes Guadalupe Ridge, Rattlesnake Canyon and Juniper Ridge are currently closed by flood damage; 'difficult' mapped to Strenuous.

hikes.name: Upper Rattlesnake Canyon to Guadalupe Ridge Loop

channel-islands.note: Per-island hiking pages (hike lists load from NPS search; facts are the 'Distance'/'Difficulty' lines in each listing; distances are round trip from the landing/visitor center). Scorpion Canyon Loop facts taken from its own place page. Left out Water Canyon Campground and Del Norte Campground hikes (campground access) and Johnson's Lee (27-28 mi gateway to backcountry beach camping). Pelican Bay requires an Island Packers escort. Torrey Pines uses the 7.5 mi loop option. No times given.

chiricahua.note: Easy/Moderate/Strenuous Hikes lists on the hiking page (loaded from NPS search); distance and duration come from each listing's summary and time field. Lower Rhyolite Canyon (1.5 mi to junction, return same way) and Echo Canyon to Visitor Center (point-to-point, shuttle) recorded one way; Bonita Creek Loop and Trail to Natural Bridge state no distance. Park is a National Monument on nps.gov.

congaree.note: Trail list on the Trail Information page (linked from Hiking); 'DIFFICULT' mapped to Strenuous. Kingsnake and Fork Swamp distances are not labeled round trip/one way. Left out Longleaf Trail (#8, 1.3 mi campground-to-visitor-center connector). No times given; several trails flagged as hard to follow after storms.

crater-lake.note: Forest/Meadow and Lake View trail tables ('Round Trip Distance'; no times). Easy = trails the page colors green; other difficulties only where the description says so (e.g. 'Moderate hike', 'Moderate to strenuous', 'Strenuous finale'); Cleetwood Cove 'steep and strenuous' from its own page. Left out the Pacific Crest Trail (33 mi through-route) and Annie Spring Spur (connector, no facts). Dutton Creek and Lightning Spring distances are to the PCT junction; Rim Trail lists no distance.

cuyahoga-valley.note: Trail Details tables on the hiking page (lengths in miles, not labeled round trip/one way; times are hiking hours where given, null where only riding/skiing time is listed) plus Blue Hen Falls from the Hiking Recommendations list. Buckeye and Valley Trail rows are point-to-point sections of longer trails; Valley Trail is shared with horses. No difficulty ratings on the page.

Buckeye Trail (Frazee House to Station Road Bridge)
Buckeye Trail (Station Road Bridge to Jaite)
Buckeye Trail (Pine Lane to Everett Covered Bridge)
Buckeye Trail (Everett Covered Bridge to Botzum Trailhead/Train Station (via Towpath and Buckeye Trails))
Valley Trail (Frazee House to Station Road Bridge)
Valley Trail (Boston Trailhead to Wetmore Trailhead)
Valley Trail (Wetmore Trailhead to Everett Covered Bridge)
Hike to Blue Hen Falls from Boston

death-valley.note: Hikes from the Easy/Moderate/Difficult lists and detail blocks on hiking.htm; Golden Canyon, Gower Gulch, Badlands Loop and the full circuit taken from golden-canyon.htm (per-route facts). Difficulty: page ranges (e.g. 'Moderate to Difficult') mapped to the harder level; Badwater Salt Flat says 'Easy to difficult depending on length' and is recorded as Easy for the 1-mi version per its list heading. Panamint Dunes is 7 mi in the list but 8 mi in its detail block (8 used). Dante's Ridge only appears in the list (no detail block).

hikes.name: Golden Canyon – Gower Gulch Complete Circuit

denali.note: Trail Details table on dayhiking.htm (distance column states one-way vs round-trip). Left out the Roadside Bike Trail and Parks Highway Bike Trail (bike paths) and the Nenana River Hiking Trail (under construction, no length). Difficulty is only stated for Savage Alpine ('considered strenuous'). Eielson/Wonder Lake trails (Tundra Loop, Thorofare Ridge, Gorge Creek, McKinley River Bar) are listed but not bus-accessible until 2027. Ranger-led discovery hikes and off-trail hiking not included.

dry-tortugas.note: No day-hike list found: drto/planyourvisit/hiking.htm exists but has no content; Things To Do and Places to Go list only Fort Jefferson, islands, boating, snorkeling, camping, etc.

everglades.note: Trail list from hiking-trails.htm and the Pine Island / Flamingo / Shark Valley area pages; distances from each trail's own page (no times or difficulty given except Sandfly Island's 40 minutes). Left out canoe trails and Shark Valley Tram Road (15-mi paved road). Long Pine Key Trails is a 22+ mi network with no single hike distance. Coastal Prairie, Snake Bight, Rowdy Bend, Christian Point, Bear Lake and Bayshore Loop are noted as passable but not maintained.

gates-of-the-arctic.note: Trail-less wilderness: backpackingandhiking.htm states there are no established trails and the park does not provide route planning, so no day hikes are listed. hiking.htm and similar URLs return 404.

gateway-arch.note: No hiking/trail page found: index and Things To Do navigation have no hiking pages, and hiking.htm/trails.htm/walking.htm etc. return 404.

glacier.note: Day Hikes lists on the five area pages linked from hikingthetrails.htm; all mileages are stated ONE-WAY (loops marked where the page or name says loop). Where a hike lists several trailhead options ([a]/[b]/[c], e.g. boat-assisted), the larger distance is used. Apgar and Fish Creek Bike Paths left out; Piegan Pass, Granite Park Chalet and Hidden Lake Overlook appear on two pages and are listed once. No times or difficulty given. Sunrift Gorge is listed as 200 ft (0.04 mi).

glacier-bay.note: Bartlett Cove trails on hiking.htm (bartlett-cove-trails.htm is only a map). 'Explore The Shore' has variable distance; recorded as its stated extended hike to Point Gustavus (6 mi one way, full day). Wilderness hiking has no maintained trails and is not included.

grand-canyon.note: Transcribed from the South Rim and North Rim Day Hikes sections of day-hiking.htm (prose). For trails with several turnaround points the largest stated day-hike distance is used (Bright Angel up to 12 mi, Hermit to Dripping Springs 7 mi, Grandview to Horseshoe Mesa 6.4 mi, North Kaibab to Roaring Springs 9.4 mi). Bright Angel Point, Transept, Uncle Jim, Widforss and Ken Patrick (west) are marked CLOSED in 2026 (Dragon Bravo Fire) but kept. url for South Rim trails is the trail's NPS PDF.

grand-teton.note: The 16 hikes in the Suggested Easy / Moderate / Strenuous Hikes lists on hike.htm; difficulty from the list heading, duration from the listing, distance and kind from each hike's Things To Do page. Where a page gives more than one route the first (standard) route is used: Forks of Cascade Canyon 9.4 mi (13.3 mi via South Jenny Lake), Lake Solitude 14.4 mi (18.3 mi via South Jenny Lake), Marion Lake 14.7 mi loop (18.8 mi out and back).

hikes.name: Heron Pond - Swan Lake Loop Trail
Death Canyon - Static Peak Divide Junction

great-basin.note: From the 'All Great Basin Hiking Trails' listing on hiking-information.htm (same hikes as the Easy/Moderate/Strenuous sub-pages); distance and difficulty from each Things To Do page, duration from the listing. Left out 'Backpack the Baker & Johnson Lakes Loop' (1–14 days) and 'Hike the Highland Route' (1–2 days). Most pages give 'Total Distance' without saying round trip/one way, so distanceKind is null there; Big Wash (20.6 mi, 12–24 hours) is kept as listed.

hikes.name: Hike to the Wheeler Peak Bristlecone Grove
Hike to Johnson Lake from Snake Creek
Hike to Johnson Lake from Baker Creek
Hike the Mountain View Nature Trail
Hike the ADA Sky Island Forest Trail

great-sand-dunes.note: Transcribed from hiking.htm (prose). The dunefield has no trails; dune destinations are listed as the page describes them. Left out the Sand Ramp Trail (described as mainly access to backpacking sites) and the long Sand Creek routes from Liberty Gate / Point of No Return. Durations for High Dune and Star Dune combine the stated average and the 'plan up to' time.

great-smoky-mountains.note: All 39 hikes in the 'Day Hikes (A - Z)' listing on day-hikes.htm; distance from each hike's Things To Do 'Length' line. Pages have no difficulty field: difficulty is set only where the page's prose calls the hike strenuous/challenging (Le Conte routes except Trillium Gap, Ramsey Cascades) or moderate (Porters Creek). Porters Creek uses its longest stated option (6 mi; 2/4/6 mi turnarounds).

hikes.name: Hike Deep Creek Trail to Indian Creek Falls
Hike the Deep Creek Waterfalls Loop
Hike the Finley Cane, Bote Mountain, Lead Cove Loop
Hike Goldmine Loop via Tunnel Bypass Trail
Hike Kephart Prong Trail to Historic CCC Camp
Hike to the Little Greenbrier School and Walker Homesite
Hike the Little River, Cucumber Gap, Jakes Creek Loop
Hike to Lynn Camp Prong Cascades
Hike to Mount Le Conte on Alum Cave Trail
Hike to Mount Le Conte on the Appalachian Trail and Boulevard Trail
Hike to Mount Le Conte on Bullhead Trail
Hike to Mount Le Conte on Rainbow Falls Trail
Hike to Mount Le Conte on Trillium Gap Trail

guadalupe-mountains.note: From the four area Day Hikes pages (McKittrick Canyon, Pine Springs, Frijole Ranch, Dog Canyon) linked from hiking.htm, plus Salt Basin Dunes from hiking.htm; facts from each Things To Do page. Left out overnight trips (Overnight on Wilderness Ridge, Overnight on McKittrick Ridge, Pine Springs to McKittrick Canyon, McKittrick Canyon to Dog Canyon, Tejas Thru Hike – all 'minimum of one night'), the general 'Hike to Fall Colors' and 'Can I Take My Dog?' items. McKittrick Ridge is kept (page: minimum one day, overnight recommended). Permian Reef uses the 4.8 mi one-way to the park boundary (4.0 mi to top of ridge); Foothills Loop 5.5 mi from Pine Springs (4.5 from Frijole Ranch).

hikes.name: The Grotto and Hunter Line Shack

haleakala.note: From the Alpine Desert, Subalpine Shrubland and Coastal District tables on hiking.htm. Keonehe‘ehe‘e (Sliding Sands) appears twice; recorded once as the 11-mile full-day crossing to Halemau‘u (the first overlook is 0.5 mi round trip). Pīpīwai is 'moderately strenuous' → Strenuous. Kaupō Trail left out (outside the park, not maintained).

hawaii-volcanoes.note: From the Day Hiking page and each linked hike page, plus the Kahuku Unit hikes listed on kahuku.htm (linked from the Day Hiking page). Kīlauea Iki uses the standard 3.3 mi loop from the overlook (5.3 / 6.0 mi from other trailheads); Footprints and Maunaiki uses 1.8 mi from Kaʻū Desert Trailhead to Maunaiki (7.0 mi more to Hilina Pali Road); Glover and Kona use the Lower Glover Trailhead distances.

hot-springs.note: From the Trails page and its Hot Springs/North Mountain and West Mountain trail tables (distances are one way per column header) plus the Sunset Trail page. These are short interconnecting trails; no difficulty ratings given except 'easy stroll' for Hot Springs Mountain Trail. Sunset Trail is ~10 mi one way (15-17 mi strenuous loop when combined); its sections (2.8/2.6/3.8 mi) not listed separately.

indiana-dunes.note: From the Hiking page's 15 trail systems (featured hikes: distance, time, difficulty); distanceKind taken from each linked trail page where it says loop or out-and-back (lollipop routes left null). 'Moderate to rugged' mapped to Strenuous. Pinhook Bog Trail left out (restricted access, ranger-accompanied only).

hikes.name: Bailly Homestead, Chellberg Farm, Little Calumet River and Mnoké Prairie Trails

isle-royale.note: The Day Hiking page's Rock Harbor/Windigo day-hike lists load dynamically (not in static HTML), so hikes come from the park's Rock Harbor and Windigo Area Guide PDFs linked from the area pages. Lookout Louise and Raspberry Island are reached by boat/paddle. Tobin/Duncan Portage (no distance) omitted.

joshua-tree.note: From the Hiking page tables (Short Walks and Nature Trails / Moderate Hikes / Strenuous Hikes) plus Black Rock-only trails from the Black Rock Area Hiking page. Short-walk difficulty is set only where the description says 'easy'. California Riding and Hiking Trail (36.6 mi, 2–3 days) omitted. Hi-View distance is from the parking area (2.1 mi from visitor center). Arch Rock is a lollipop (kind null).

katmai.note: From Brooks Camp Hiking Trails (page states all distances are one way). Lake Brooks Road and the 23-mi Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes Road omitted as roads. Dumpling Mountain distance is to the overlook; summit is another 2.5 mi.

kenai-fjords.note: Only maintained trails are the Exit Glacier trails and Harding Icefield Trail. Glacier Overlook Trail is described as 'moderately strenuous' (mapped to Strenuous); its 0.6 mi is the continuation beyond the Glacier View Loop kiosk.

kings-canyon.note: Grant Grove, Redwood Canyon and Cedar Grove day-hike pages (shared SEKI site). Redwood Canyon trails are listed as closed since the 2021 KNP Complex Fire. Converse Basin/Boole Tree (Sequoia National Forest) omitted. Several Cedar Grove entries give no distance; 'moderately strenuous' mapped to Strenuous.

hikes.name: Hart Tree and Fallen Goliath Loop

kobuk-valley.note: No day-hike list: the park states it has no roads, trails, calculated mileages or maps; visits are fly-in backcountry trips (e.g. Great Kobuk Sand Dunes, Onion Portage). Also checked planyourvisit/index.htm and hiking.htm (404).

lake-clark.note: From the park's Day Hikes page (Tanalian Trails from Port Alsworth plus the Portage Creek Trail). Portage Creek's 3.25 mi is not labeled one-way or round trip; Teetering Rock is an unmaintained route with no distance given.

lassen-volcanic.note: From the Trail Conditions (May–October) tables of popular day hikes, which give difficulty stars and round-trip miles; 'Moderately Strenuous' (***) mapped to Strenuous. Juniper Lake trails and Summit Lake loop show 'Variable' distance (null); PCT row left out.

hikes.name: Summit Lake to Cluster/Twin Lakes Loop
Little Willow Lake to Terminal Geyser
Warner Valley Road to Juniper Lake (a.k.a. Heart Rate Hill)

mesa-verde.note: From the Hiking Mesa Verde page (Morefield, Chapin Mesa and Wetherill Mesa trails). Petroglyph Point 'Very Challenging' mapped to Strenuous.

mammoth-cave.note: Trail tables on the Visitor Center Area & South Side and Backcountry Trails pages (linked from hiking.htm); distances are as listed with no round-trip/one-way label and no difficulty. Left out campsite/spur/access connectors; backcountry trails are segments the park says suit day hikes or multi-day trips. Heritage and Cedar Sink durations from their Things To Do pages.

hikes.name: Mammoth Cave Railroad Bike and Hike Trail - North
Mammoth Cave Railroad Bike and Hike Trail - South

mount-rainier.note: Area-page trails with distance/time taken from each hike's own page (which sometimes differs from the list, e.g. Skyline 5.5 vs 5 mi, Lake James 22 vs 27 mi; where a page gives two destinations the longer is used), plus the family trails on Day Hiking at Mount Rainier. Left out Wonderland Trail, Northern Loop, and Klapatche Park and Indian Bar (their pages give a hiking time of 2 days). Difficulty only where a hike page states it (Naches Peak 'easy loop', Rampart Ridge 'moderate loop').

hikes.name: Comet Falls & Van Trump Park Trail
Dege Peak via Sourdough Ridge Trail
Carbon River Rain Forest Nature Trail

new-river-gorge.note: Trails listed on the six hiking-area pages linked from hiking.htm; length (with its one-way/round-trip label) and difficulty from each trail's nps.gov/places page Quick Facts. 'X to Y' difficulties use the harder one. Left out the two short connector trails.

north-cascades.note: Day Hiking page (grouped by time: under an hour / 1–2 hours / half day / full day, used as duration), its Newhalem Area Trails page, and Stehekin Trails (one-way miles, Easy/Moderate/Strenuous headings). Newhalem boardwalk lengths given in feet were converted (330 ft, 1,000 ft); Happy Creek is printed as '.03 mile' loop and kept as written. East Bank Trail has variable distance. Difficulty elsewhere only where the text says moderate/difficult/strenuous.

hikes.name: Rock Shelter and Newhalem Creek Trail
Trail of the Cedars Nature Walk
Company Creek to Glacier Peak Wilderness

olympic.note: From Day Hiking at Olympic (rain forest, mountain, lowland forest and coastal hikes); no durations or difficulty ratings given. Meadow Loop Trails are '0.25 to 0.5 mile' (larger used); Klahhane Ridge's 2.8 mi is to a junction; the 9-mile Cape Alava–Sand Point beach loop is mentioned but not named, so left out.

petrified-forest.note: Developed trails from the Trails page plus the backcountry routes on the Off the Beaten Path page (route-finding, distances approximate). No durations or difficulty ratings given except Dead Wash ('moderately difficult'); Devils Playground (permit-only, no distance) left out.

pinnacles.note: All hikes from the Trails of Pinnacles page, grouped by trailhead. The page labels loops as 'round trip', kept as written; 'Easy to Moderate' recorded as Moderate, 'Moderate to Strenuous' as Strenuous.

hikes.name: Campground to Bear Gulch Day Use Area
Moses Spring to Rim Trail Loop
Condor Gulch to High Peaks Loop
High Peaks to Bear Gulch Loop
Old Pinnacles Trail to Balconies Cave
High Peaks to Balconies Cave Loop

redwood.note: North and South Area trail lists plus Coastal Trail sections. Left out Mill Creek Horse Trail, Elam Loop/Horse Camp (20 mi) and 44 Loop/Backcountry Camp (32 mi). Most mileages carry no one-way/round-trip label (null); difficulty null where the page only says e.g. 'Non-level, some grades'. Little Bald Hills uses 4.8 (to park boundary); Redwood Creek uses 8 (to Tall Trees Grove Trail); some linked pages are nps.gov/places or /thingstodo pages.

hikes.name: Coastal Trail – Gold Bluffs Beach Section

rocky-mountain.note: Every destination in the List of Hiking Trails table (distance one way per the header). No durations or difficulty given. Bierstadt Lake and Odessa Lake appear from two trailheads and are listed twice with '(from <trailhead>)'.

saguaro.note: Hiking Trail Recommendations page (Rincon Mountain and Tucson Mountain districts). Distances mostly lack one-way/round-trip labels. Tanque Verde Ridge distance 'varies' (null); Sendero Esperanza uses 8 mi (upper end of 3.4–8, to Wasson Peak).

hikes.name: Sendero Esperanza Trail to the Ridge/To Wasson Peak

sequoia.note: Sequoia-side pages only (Foothills, Giant Forest & Lodgepole, Mineral King); Grant Grove and Cedar Grove left for Kings Canyon. The 'Other popular Giant Forest trails' are listed by name only (no facts). Middle Fork Trail distance is to Panther Creek Falls; Moro Rock has no distance; North Fork Trail has no facts.

shenandoah.note: The All Hikes list (rendered by nps.gov's own search; 46 of its 48 entries resolved), with facts from each hike's nps.gov Things To Do page. 'Circuit' recorded as loop; Easiest→Easy, Moderately/Very Strenuous→Strenuous; duration is the page's 'Hiking Time'.

hikes.name: Old Rag Summit via Berry Hollow

theodore-roosevelt.note: Hiking and Trail Guide table (distances are round trip per the header; Loop-named trails recorded as loop, Maah Daah Hey section one way). Difficulty from section headings: 'Easy to Moderate'→Moderate, 'Moderate to Strenuous'→Strenuous. Little Mo/Coal Vein use the outer-loop distance; Upper Paddock/Talkington uses 15.4 mi (19.4 if started from Painted Canyon).

hikes.name: Prairie Dog Town via the Buckhorn Trail
Sperati Point via the Achenbach Trail

virgin-islands.note: The 'Park Hiking Trails' list on the Hiking page (10 entries; the page says 20+ trails exist but only these are listed), with facts from each linked Things To Do page. Reef Bay/L'Esperance distances are one way to the beach; Cinnamon Bay entry combines a 0.5 mi easy loop and a 1 mi strenuous trail (larger recorded); Salt Pond Bay/Ram Head distance left null (1/4 mi to beach plus 'just under a mile'); 'moderately strenuous'→Strenuous; 'Hike the' prefix dropped from Lind Point.

hikes.name: Salt Pond Bay and Ram Head Trails

voyageurs.note: Land Access and Water Access (boat-only trailheads) lists on the Hiking Trails page, facts from each Things To Do page. Left out the multi-day Kab-Ash Trail. Tilson Connector is mainly a ski trail (its duration is skiing time, so null). Echo Bay lists '1.5 mile / 2.5 mile loop' (2.5 recorded). 'Hike'/'Hike the' prefixes dropped from names.

white-sands.note: The five established trails on the Hiking page, facts from each Things To Do page ('Hiking' prefix dropped). Backcountry Camping Trail is a 2 mi day-hikeable loop ('moderate to strenuous'→Strenuous). Interdune Boardwalk is currently closed (safety corridor).

wind-cave.note: All trails on the Hiking page; difficulty from its Easy/Moderate/Strenuous headings. The page says mileages are one way unless noted, so unlabeled distances are 'one way'. No durations given. Cold Brook Canyon lists 1.4 miles / 3.5 km (mile figure kept).

wrangell-st-elias.note: Day Hiking page's area sub-pages; distances/times from each trail's nps.gov PDF (url), difficulty from the list page (else the PDF). Left out trails the park says are outside the park and not NPS-maintained (Copper Center/Chitina PDFs, Yakutat/Tongass trails) and the Kennecott map PDF. Trail Creek/Lost Creek: maintained trail 6/7 mi one way, 10 mi to the pass (recorded). Skookum Volcano is 2.5 mi to the pass; 'moderately strenuous'→Strenuous.

hikes.name: The Wagon Road & Toe of the Kennicott Glacier

yellowstone.note: The seven area 'Day Hikes in the … Area' trip-idea pages linked from the park's Hiking page (sources are those area pages), with facts from each trail's Things To Do page. There-and-back→round trip; lollipop→loop; Lava Creek and Rescue Creek are one-way through-hikes; Avalanche Peak is 2.1 mi up (one way). 'Moderately strenuous'→Strenuous, 'Moderately easy'→Moderate; Harlequin Lake/Fairy Falls/Lone Star/Lava Creek difficulty taken from the page's difficulty tag. Mammoth Hot Springs Trails has no distance or single rating (tagged easy but its terrace stairs are called strenuous), left null.

hikes.name: Blacktail Deer Creek to Yellowstone River Trail
Forces of the Northern Range Self-guided Trail

yosemite.note: Six area day-hike pages linked from the Hiking page. Yosemite Valley table gives difficulty (ranges → harder) and distance (largest option); times from each Valley trail's own page (Vernal/Nevada time left null since its 8 mi max has no matching time). Other areas give no ratings except Chilnualna Falls and Alder Creek ('very challenging'→Strenuous). Four Mile Trail listed once (Valley entry, time from Glacier Point page). Glacier Point Overlook 300 yds converted to 0.2 mi. Left out the multi-day Laurel/Vernon/Rancheria Loop; the park's trails.htm is backpacking descriptions, not used.

hikes.name: Vernal Fall and Nevada Fall Trails
Mariposa Grove Trail to Wawona Point

zion.note: Five area trail pages linked from Hiking in Zion. Zion Canyon difficulty from its Easy/Moderate/Strenuous sections; Canyon/Kolob Canyons facts from each Things To Do page (mostly 'Length (one way)'). Wilderness-page distances as labelled; Deertrap/Cable Mountain/Coalpits Wash times cover only part of the route, so null. Canyon Overlook (also on East Rim page) listed once. Left out Stave Spring Trail (0.3 mi access path). The Narrows has no set distance; Angels Landing 0.5 mi is the chain section only (reached via Scout Lookout).

hikes.name: La Verkin Creek Trail to Kolob Arch
West Rim Trail via Lava Point
East Mesa Trail to Observation Point
